name: go-modern-guidelines
description: Help AI coding agents write modern Go
one_liner: A style guide that teaches AI coding assistants to write cleaner, more modern Go code instead of outdated patterns.
buyer: Honestly, this is a free reference for developers and AI agents — not something with a standalone buyer.
business_use_cases: A Go shop feeds these guidelines into their AI coding assistant so generated code matches modern style automatically.
A coding-agent vendor bundles similar language-specific guideline packs as a selling point for their product.
A consultancy uses it as a checklist when reviewing a client's AI-generated Go code.

money_ideas.idea: Package a small business selling similarly curated style-guide packs for other languages to dev tool vendors.

steal_this: Not much of a weekend product here — at most, bundle the idea into curated agent style-guides for 5 more languages, sold as a pack to dev tool companies.
